extractions.value: Patient homozygous for HLA DR3 and DQ2. Sural nerve biopsy revealed mild axonopathy; muscle biopsy showed mild denervation and reinnervation. EMG was normal but performed only after initiation of diazepam and baclofen. Plasmapheresis was the most effective treatment, reducing GAD65 autoantibody levels and controlling clinical symptoms; stopping plasmapheresis resulted in rebound of antibodies and symptom recurrence. IVIG did not reduce GAD65 autoantibody levels but provided clinical improvement. Patient developed Staphylococcus aureus line infection with endocarditis in May 1997.
